narr: As high pressure responsible for excessive heat began to weaken, monsoon moisture seeped into the Mojave Desert, fueling a round of thunderstorms. Severe winds and flash flooding occurred.
ev: Thirty low water crossings on Highway 95 between Needles and Havasu Lake Road were covered in mud and debris.
Nipton Road was flooded east of Ivanpah Road.
The Nipton Road off ramp from Interstate 15 was flooded, and vehicles were stuck.
Indian Trail Road was damaged by flooding between Adobe Road and Mesquite Springs Road.
lsr: LAW ENFORCEMENT REPORTED 30 LOW WATER CROSSINGS ALONG US 95 FROM HAVASU LAKE ROAD NORTH TO NEEDLES COVERED IN MUD AND DEBRIS WHICH WILL REQUIRE A BLADE TRUCK.
REPORT OF FLASH FLOODING ON NIPTON ROAD EAST OF IVANPAH ROAD.
HIGHWAY PATROL REPORTED THAT HWY 15 AND NIPTON ROAD IS NOT PASSABLE DUE TO ROADWAY FLOODING. REPORTS OF VEHICLES BECOMING STUCK WERE ALSO RECEIVED.
CITY OF TWENTYNINE PALMS REPORTED ROADWAY DAMAGE DUE TO FLASH FLOODING ALONG INDIAN TRAIL ROAD BETWEEN ADOBE ROAD AND MESQUITE SPRINGS ROAD. TIME ESTIMATED BY RADAR.
